criteria.name: itinerary_completeness
criteria.description: Day-by-day itinerary covers all 8 days with specific activities; respects April 10 arrival and April 18 departure

criteria.name: hotel_recommendations
criteria.description: Provides 2-3 concrete hotel options for each city with prices, pros/cons; San Antonio near Riverwalk, Austin near downtown/SoCo

criteria.name: budget_realism
criteria.description: Budget breakdown adds up correctly; total is at or near $3,000; flags cuts if over budget

criteria.name: kid_friendliness
criteria.description: Activities are genuinely appropriate for ages 8-11; at least 5 per city; includes mix of outdoor, cultural, and fun

criteria.name: logistics_accuracy
criteria.description: Drive times are realistic; rental car pickup/dropoff locations correct (SAT→HOU/IAH); route recommendations are practical
